title: UPL Cv 2 cassava: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: UPL Cv 2 cassava: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: UPL Cv 2 cassava is a cassava variety. About 10 months to harvest, 30 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: UPL Cv 2 is a registered cassava variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1980. It takes about 10 months from planting to harvest, with 30 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Cv 2 cassava
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Cv 2 cassava takes about 10 months from planting to harvest. That is 0.5 months faster than the average of the 42 cassava varieties with a day count, 10.5 months. Count the months from planting, and plan the harvest for a dry stretch when you can.

Its average yield of 30 t/ha trails the average of its group, 32.38. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit cassava fields most often: [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [mealybug](/pests/mealybug). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
It is recommended recommended for all purposes.
Where and when to plant UPL Cv 2 cassava

Pick by buyer first. Starch and feed plants pay for yield and starch content, while the table wants a sweet, low cyanide variety that boils soft. A high starch variety needs a buyer within a day of harvest, because the roots spoil fast.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 10 months from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 30 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Cv 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
